title: Microsoft Teams: automatic recording and transcription for call queues
summary: The briefing passes: the recording controls, prerequisites, licensing and rollout facts are supported. Minor corrections should acknowledge conflicting command documentation, distinguish recording-specific pricing from general SharePoint capacity costs, and remove a checklist instruction without a corresponding control row.
